text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training, Tokai Teio got injured,
so I took her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: There's really no need to worry so much!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
An injury like this will heal in no time!
Starting tomorrow, I can even—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...No way.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No way, not me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I won't let an injury get in my way!
When I say I'm gonna do it—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ouch!
choice_data_list: I don't want you pushing yourself too hard.
Can you run in that condition?
Can you run in that condition?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ouch!
choice_data_list: I don't want you pushing yourself too hard.
Can you run in that condition?
Can you run in that condition?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.
choice_data_list: At least rest up for today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Just for today, only for today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... It's all because... you said so, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Truth is... I'm not gonna let
a little injury beat me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that day,
I made sure Tokai Teio got plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I can run! I can totally run!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Come on...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ow!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: It'll get better if you just take a proper day of rest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio spent the rest of that day with a frustrated look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer!
I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because I'm the invincible Teio!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Have some faith in me, Trainer.
After all, I'm the Umamusume you're in charge of, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, no matter how many times it takes,
I'll always get back on my feet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The next day, Tokai Teio showed herself
to be stronger and more invincible than ever before.
